about: What was left (a) of this records job: gate 67 prints TC-SELCLS-CONSUMERS, so the case row can cite a log line. The line counts every assertion of gate 67's blocks U, P, G and D (the sel/cls consumer checks) and is red if any failed or fewer than 20 ran. Graded by gate 67 on a trial bundle (its blocks are node and one browser launch; the line carries no geometry). NOT COVERED: TC-R09b and TC-RL-070 themselves (rows since #546, read by the citations door), and the TC-LS-001..034 ruling (the orchestrator's).

breaks.name: drill-grades-take-book-not-miss
breaks.why: a consumer of the grade goes wrong (the drill's admissible grades lose Miss and gain Book), so the consumer checks fail and the case line must go red with them

breaks.name: the-consumer-count-counts-nothing
breaks.why: the wrapper counts nothing, so the case line would pass over an empty count; it must go red on the 20-assertion floor
